questions.question: AB is a chord of the circle and its center is “O”. ON is perpendicular to AB. If the length of AB = 20 cm, ON = (2√11) cm, find the radius (in cm) of the circle.
questions.solution:
**Detailed solution:-

 ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8874174f9619ebdf98d63e29c2bcf216fc8f78804a7dcdfd66fa9fb9f6ae6bfa.png] 

As, perpendicular from the centre bisects the chord so as ON is perpendicular to AB

AN = AB/2 = 20/2 = 10 cm

And, ON = 2√11 cm

Now, triangle ONA is a right angled triangle, right angle at N

So, OA = √(ON² + AN²) = √{(10)² + (2√11)²} = √144 = 12 cm

∴ Radius of circle is 12 cm

questions.question: The largest chord of the circle has a length of 20.4 cm. the radius of the circle will be ______.

questions.question: Rs. 6300 is divided among A, B and C in the ratio of 1/2 : 1 : 3/5. What is the share (in Rs.) of B?
questions.solution:
**Given :- **

Rs. 6300 is divided among A, B, and C in the ratio of 1/2: 1 : 3/5.

**Formula used:- **

The share of B = (B × Total amount) / (A+B+C) 

**Calculation:-**

Ratio of share between A, B and C = (1/2) ∶ 1 ∶ (3/5) = 5 ∶ 10 ∶ 6

∴ B’s share = {10/(5 + 10 + 6)} × total amount = (10/21) × 6300 = 3000

questions.question: U and V started a business by investing amounts Rs. 184000 and Rs. 224000 respectively. If U’s share in the profit received at the end of year is Rs. 20700, then what will be the total profit (in Rs.) earned by them together?
questions.solution:
Ratio of profit = (investment × time) of U ∶ (investment × time) of V

Ratio of profit = (184000 × 1) ∶ (224000 × 1) = 23 ∶ 28

U’s share in profit = {23/(23 + 28)} × Total profit = (23/51) × total profit

According to the question,

(23/51) × total profit = 20700

∴ Total profit = 20700 × (51/23) = 45900

questions.question: Selling price of a table is Rs. 2808. If profit percentage is 17%, then what is the cost price (in Rs.) of table?
questions.solution:
Let cost price be x

Selling price = Rs. 2808

Profit % = {(selling price – cost price)/Cost price} × 100 = {(2808 – x)/x} × 100

According to the question,

⇒ 17 = {(2808 – x)/x} × 100

⇒ 0.17x = 2808 – x

⇒ 1.17x = 2808

⇒ x = 2400

∴ Cost price is Rs. 2400

questions.question: The marked price of a chair is 40% more than its cost price. If the chair is sold for Rs. 520 after a discount of Rs. 40, then what will be the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
Let the cost price be Rs. x

Marked price = x + 40% of x = Rs. 1.4x

Discount = 40

Selling price = 1.4x – 40

According to the question,

⇒ 1.4x – 40 = 520

⇒ 1.4x = 560

⇒ x = 400

⇒ Cost price = Rs. 400

∴ Profit % = {(selling price – cost price)/Cost price} × 100 = {(520 – 400)/400} × 100 = 30%

questions.question:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are **TRUE**?

I. 2√3 > 3√2

II. 4√2 > 2√8
questions.solution:
Statement I:

2√3 > 3√2

To Check either above given relation is correct or not, simplifying by squaring on both the sides.

⇒ (2√3)² > (3√2)²

⇒ 12 > 18 which is not true, as we know that 18 is greater than 12.

So, the given relation in statement I is not true.

Statement II:

Now, simplifying the values given in statement II

(Note: 2√8 = 2√(4 × 2) = 4√2)

4√2 > 2√8 on taking the square root from the right hand side.

⇒ 4√2 > 2 × 2√2

⇒ 4√2 > 4√2 which is not true, as the the value on left hand side is equal to the value on right hand side. 

So, the given relation in statement II is also not true.

∴ Neither statement I nor statement II is true

questions.question: X, Y and Z can do a piece of work in 30, 40 and 50 days respectively. All three of them began the work together but Y left 4 days before completion of the work. In how many days was the work completed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

X, Y and Z can do a piece of work in 30, 40 and 50 days respectively.

Y left 4 days before completion.

**Concept used:**

If one can complete a work in w days then work done by him per day = 1/w

**Calculation:**

Work done by X in one day = 1/30

Work done by Y in one day = 1/40

Work done by Z in one day = 1/50

As, Y left 4 days before completion so only X and Y worked for 4 days

Work done by (X + Y + Z) in one day = (1/30) + (1/40) + (1/50) = 47/600

Work done by (X + Z) in one day = (1/30) + (1/50) = 32/600

questions.question: A train is moving at the speed of 72 km/hr. How many seconds will it take to cover a distance of 1400 m?
questions.solution:
Speed of train = 72 km/hr = 72 × (5/18) m/sec = 20 m/sec

Distance to be covered = 1400 m

Now, 

Speed = Distance/time

∴ Time = Distance/speed = 1400/20 = 70 seconds

questions.question: The length of the diagonal and the breadth of a rectangle are 17 cm and 8 cm respectively. Find its perimeter (in cm).
questions.solution:
As, each angle of a rectangle is 90°

Length = √{(diagonal)² – (breadth)²} = √{(17)² – (8)²} = 15 cm

Now,

∴ Perimeter of a rectangle = 2(length + breadth) = 2(15 + 8) = 46 cm

questions.question: The area of a semicircle is 1925 cm². Calculate its perimeter (in cm).
questions.solution:
Area of semicircle = (1/2) × π × Radius²

⇒ 1925 = (1/2) × (22/7) × Radius²

⇒ Radius² = 1225

⇒ Radius = 35

Now,

∴ Perimeter = (π + 2) × radius = {(22/7) + 2} × 35 = 180 cm

questions.question: The surface area of a sphere is 5544 cm². Find its diameter (in cm).
questions.solution:
Surface area of a sphere = 4 × π × Radius²

⇒ 5544 = 4 × (22/7) × Radius²

⇒ Radius² = 441

⇒ Radius = 21

Now,

∴ Diameter = 2 × Radius = 2 × 21 = 42 cm

In ∆UVW measure of angle V is 90°. If Cosec U = 13/12, and UV = 2.5cm, then what is the length (in cm) of side VW?
questions.solution:
As,

cosec U = 13/12

⇒ UW/VW = 13/12

⇒ UW = 13k and VW = 12k

Now, in a right angle triangle by Pythagoras theorem,

UV² + VW² = UW²

⇒ (2.5)² + (12k)² = (13k)²

⇒ 6.25 + 144k² = 169k²

⇒ 25k² = 6.25

⇒ k² = 0.25

⇒ k = 0.5

Now,

∴ VW = 12k = 12 × 0.5 = 6 cm
